AND fi.storage_platform_setting_id IS NULL
AND fi.storage_platform_setting_id = #{storagePlatformSettingId}

AND (fi.original_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR fi.display_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND fi.is_dir = 0 AND fi.suffix IN

ORDER BY fi.is_dir DESC
, CASE WHEN fi.display_name ~ '[0-9]' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC , LOWER(SUBSTRING(fi.display_name FROM '^[^0-9]*')) ASC , CAST(NULLIF((SELECT (regexp_matches(fi.display_name, '[0-9]+', 'g'))[1] LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0), '') AS BIGINT) ASC , CAST(NULLIF((SELECT (regexp_matches(fi.display_name, '[0-9]+', 'g'))[1] LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1), '') AS BIGINT) ASC , CAST(NULLIF((SELECT (regexp_matches(fi.display_name, '[0-9]+', 'g'))[1] LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2), '') AS BIGINT) ASC , LOWER(fi.display_name) ASC
